  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__base__src_base>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__base__src_base_log>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__base__src_datauri_utils>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__base__src_string_utils>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__base__src_time_utils>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__base__src_values>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__core__base_json_utils>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__core__build>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__devtool__base_devtool__native__js_inspect_base_devtool_js_inspect>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__devtool__base_devtool__native_android_jni>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__devtool__base_devtool__native_base_devtool>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__devtool__base_devtool__native_base_devtool_jni>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__devtool__fundamentals__js_inspect_js_inspect_interface>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__third_party__jsoncpp>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__third_party__modp_b64>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:lynx__third_party__rapidjson>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:third_party__cpu-features_cpu_features>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:third_party__zlib>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:third_party__zlib_zlib_adler32_simd>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:third_party__zlib_zlib_arm_crc32>
  
  $<TARGET_OBJECTS:third_party__zlib_zlib_inflate_chunk_simd>
  )

  ${ROOT_PATH}/lynx/tools/android_tools/ndk/sources/cxx-stl/llvm-libc++/libs/arm64-v8a/
  )

  android
  c
  dl
  log
  m
  )

# Compiler and Linker flags
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS} -Wl,--fatal-warnings -fPIC -Wl,-z,noexecstack -Wl,-z,now -Wl,-z,relro -Wl,-z,defs -Wl,--undefined-version --gcc-toolchain=/home/zsy/zsy/lynx/tools/android_tools/ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64 -Wl,--no-undefined -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL -fuse-ld=lld -Wl,--icf=all --target=aarch64-linux-android22 -Wl,--warn-shared-textrel --sysroot=/home/zsy/zsy/lynx/tools/android_tools/ndk/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/sysroot  -Wl,--warn-shared-textrel -Wl,-O2 -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--as-needed -flto -O2 -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL -Xlinker -Map=output.map ")
